duplicateDependencies.name: hashbrown
duplicateDependencies.constraint: The wasmi 1.1 variation runtime resolves hashbrown 0.15 through wasmi_collections and string-interner, while the workspace indexmap dependency resolves hashbrown 0.17.
duplicateDependencies.replacementCondition: Remove version 0.15 after wasmi/string-interner aligns with the indexmap dependency and the variable-font reduction regression suite passes.

duplicateDependencies.name: miniz_oxide
duplicateDependencies.constraint: The miette backtrace chain resolves miniz_oxide 0.8, while flate2 resolves miniz_oxide 0.9 for font compression.
duplicateDependencies.replacementCondition: Remove version 0.8 when backtrace aligns with flate2 without changing diagnostics or compression behavior.

duplicateDependencies.name: syn
duplicateDependencies.constraint: Several established derive crates still resolve syn 2, while current async-trait, serde, thiserror, tokio, and font tooling resolve syn 3.
duplicateDependencies.replacementCondition: Remove syn 2 after the remaining procedural-macro dependencies adopt syn 3 and all compile-time checks pass.

duplicateDependencies.name: unicode-width
duplicateDependencies.constraint: miette 7 currently resolves unicode-width directly and through textwrap at different compatible major versions.
duplicateDependencies.replacementCondition: Remove the older version when a miette/textwrap release unifies the dependency without changing diagnostics.
